description: This file acts as a central aggregator for various helper modules and functionalities related to agent runtime in a plugin SDK, primarily exporting modules, functions, types, and constants for use elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: dedupeProfileIds
methods.description: Removes duplicate profile IDs from a list to ensure uniqueness.

methods.name: listProfilesForProvider
methods.description: Lists available profiles for a given provider.

methods.name: markAuthProfileGood
methods.description: Marks an authentication profile as successfully used.

methods.name: setAuthProfileOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of authentication profiles based on usage or configuration.

methods.name: upsertAuthProfile
methods.description: Inserts or updates an authentication profile in the store.

methods.name: upsertAuthProfileWithLock
methods.description: Safely inserts or updates an authentication profile with locking to prevent race conditions.

methods.name: repairOAuthProfileIdMismatch
methods.description: Fixes mismatches in OAuth profile IDs.

methods.name: suggestOAuthProfileIdForLegacyDefault
methods.description: Suggests OAuth profile IDs for legacy default profiles.

methods.name: clearRuntimeAuthProfileStoreSnapshots
methods.description: Clears stored snapshots of the auth profile store.

methods.name: ensureAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Ensures that the auth profile store is initialized.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStoreForSecretsRuntime
methods.description: Loads the auth profile store specific to secrets runtime.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStoreForRuntime
methods.description: Loads the auth profile store for runtime operations.

methods.name: replaceRuntimeAuthProfileStoreSnapshots
methods.description: Replaces snapshots of the auth profile store.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Loads the auth profile store.

methods.name: saveAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Saves the current state of the auth profile store.

methods.name: calculateAuthProfileCooldownMs
methods.description: Calculates cooldown period in milliseconds for a profile.

methods.name: clearAuthProfileCooldown
methods.description: Clears cooldown for a profile.

methods.name: clearExpiredCooldowns
methods.description: Clears all expired cooldowns.

methods.name: getSoonestCooldownExpiry
methods.description: Gets the earliest expiration time among cooldowns.

methods.name: isProfileInCooldown
methods.description: Checks if a profile is currently in cooldown.

methods.name: markAuthProfileCooldown
methods.description: Marks an auth profile as in cooldown.

methods.name: markAuthProfileFailure
methods.description: Marks a profile as having failed.

methods.name: markAuthProfileUsed
methods.description: Records that a profile has been used.

methods.name: resolveProfilesUnavailableReason
methods.description: Resolves why profiles are unavailable.

methods.name: resolveProfileUnusableUntilForDisplay
methods.description: Resolves when a profile becomes usable again for display purposes.

methods.name: resolveApiKeyForProfile
methods.description: Resolves the API key associated with a profile.

methods.name: resolveAuthProfileDisplayLabel
methods.description: Generates a display label for an auth profile.

methods.name: formatAuthDoctorHint
methods.description: Formats hints for auth doctor UI.

methods.name: resolveAuthProfileEligibility
methods.description: Determines if a profile is eligible for use.

methods.name: resolveAuthProfileOrder
methods.description: Resolves the order of auth profiles.

methods.name: resolveAuthStorePathForDisplay
methods.description: Resolves the storage path of the auth profile store for display.
